text: Authorized by owner to proceed. Implement explicit versioned fixed-basis semantic localization with source-target conditional normalization; preserve v1. Reject unsupported semantic imputation and disabled-term support inflation. General heterogeneous observed-term sum rejected because missing source structure can make targets artificially cheaper. Freeze synthetic hypotheses and annotations/visual/combined evaluation before comparisons. Existing NN03 cases are development diagnostics, not independent accuracy validation. Standalone checkout, scoped serial gates, exact-commit independent review; no merge/push. Source transcripts/media stay in place.
